text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Inso lvensi ( Pemohon bagi
Pendaftaran Penama) 2019.

Pemohon bagi Pendaftaran penama

2. Orang yang dinamakan dalam Jadual ditetapkan sebagai pemohon bagi maksud
subperenggan 2G(1)(a)(iii) Akta Insolvensi 1967.

JADUAL

Sik Poh Meng
Ang Guan Seng
Mohan a/l Muniyandi
Selvamuthu Raja a/l Muthusamy

Dibuat 19 Jun 2019
[Mdi.BDPKS-600-2/1(25); PN(PU2)180/IV]

DATUK LIEW VUI KEONG
Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri

INSOLVENCY ACT 1967

INSOLVENCY (APPLICANT FOR REGISTRATION OF NOMINEE) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subparagraph 2G(1)(a)(iii) of the
Insolvency Act 1967 [Act 360 ], the Minister, on recommendation of the
Director General of Insolvency, makes the following order:

Citation
1. This order may be cited as the Insolvency ( Applicant for Registration of
Nominee) Order 2019.

Applicant for registration of nominee
2. The persons named in the Schedule are prescribed as applicant for the purpose of
subparagraph 2G(1)(a)(iii) of the Insolvency Act 1967.

SCHEDULE

Sik Poh Meng
 Ang Guan Seng
Mohan a/l Muniyandi
 Selvamuthu Raja a/l Muthusamy
